result.keyPoints:
•本季營業收入為 0.69 億美元，營業利益為 0.08 億美元，營業利益率達 11.6%。
•本期淨利為 0.04 億美元，淨利率為 5.8%，每股盈餘（EPS）為 0.18 美元。
•官方新聞稿提及第三季總營收為 6,980 萬美元（扣除 reimbursements 前為 6,890 萬美元），GAAP 稀釋每股盈餘為 0.14 美元，調整後稀釋每股盈餘為 0.39 美元。
result.guidanceOfficial:
• The Company estimates total revenue before reimbursements for the fourth quarter of 2026 will be in the range of 6,800 萬美元 to 7,000 萬美元 and reflects the 6% to 8% fewer available days due to increased holidays and vacation taken when compared to the third quarter.
• The Company estimates adjusted diluted earnings per share for the fourth quarter of 2026 to be in the range of $0.39 and $0.41, assuming a GAAP effective tax rate of 26.5%.
• We estimate cash flow from operations to be up on a sequential basis by approximately 1,500 萬美元 to 2,000 萬美元, with a corresponding decrease in accounts receivable of 400 萬美元 to 500 萬美元.
